# The Dog Show (dogshow.lol)

> The Dog Show is "the internet's least serious dog show" — a free, live online stream where a rotation of real dogs, uploaded by their owners, takes the stage while viewers watch together and throw "bones" (votes). Each calendar month the most-voted dog is crowned Best in Show. Owners can enter their own dog, and the site publishes plain-spoken, genuinely useful guides to popular and designer-mix dog breeds.

Key facts:
- Watching the live show is free. Registering (a free Dog Entry account) grants 50 bones (votes) to throw, and lets you chat, upload your own dog, and get a certificate page.
- Entering your own dog is FREE — no subscription. Money only buys bones: a Dog Entry Pro account is $1.99 (everything free, plus 250 bones) and a Top Dog account is $5.99 (everything, plus 1000 bones and the ability to book your dog's stage slot for 3× stage time). A $1.99 bone pack adds 250 bones to any account.
- A monthly "Best in Show" race crowns the dog with the most votes that month. A monthly "Best in Breed" ribbon also goes to the most-voted dog of each breed with at least 3 entered dogs — both are permanent awards on the dog's certificate page.
- One dog per account. Dogs are real, owner-submitted photos; testimonials are real and owner-submitted.
- Made by Scheme Studio. Contact: james@wearescheme.studio.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://dogshow.lol/): What The Dog Show is, how it works, pricing, and how to enter your dog.

- [Watch the live show](https://dogshow.lol/show): The live rotating stage of dogs, with viewer chat, voting, and the monthly Best in Show race.
- [All Dogs gallery](https://dogshow.lol/dogs): Every dog that has appeared on stage — searchable and sortable.
- [About](https://dogshow.lol/about): The story behind The Dog Show and how to get in touch.

## Breed guides
> Long-form, plainly written guides to popular and designer-mix breeds — temperament, owner-fit, care, history, and famous examples. The site's most informative, citable content.
- [Breed guide index](https://dogshow.lol/breeds): Directory of all published breed guides.
- [Bernedoodle](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/bernedoodle): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Bernese Mountain Dog × Poodle cross.
- [Goldendoodle](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/goldendoodle): Guide to the Golden Retriever × Poodle cross.
- [Labradoodle](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/labradoodle): Guide to the Labrador × Poodle cross.
- [Australian Labradoodle](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/australian-labradoodle): The multi-generational Australian Labradoodle, distinct from the first-cross Labradoodle.
- [Cockapoo](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/cockapoo): Guide to the Cocker Spaniel × Poodle cross.
- [Cavalier King Charles Spaniel](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/cavalier-king-charles-spaniel): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, the devoted toy spaniel with serious inherited heart and neurological concerns that every owner must understand.
- [Cocker Spaniel](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/cocker-spaniel): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Cocker Spaniel, America's littlest sporting dog (American Cocker, 13.5–15.5") and its larger English cousin (15–17")—with honest guidance on the breed's defining health challenge: ear infections.
- [Cavapoo](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/cavapoo): Guide to the Cavalier King Charles Spaniel × Poodle cross.
- [Chihuahua](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/chihuahua): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Chihuahua, the tiny Mexican dog that weighs under six pounds but believes it owns the room.
- [Maltipoo](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/maltipoo): Guide to the Maltese × Poodle cross.
- [Pomsky](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/pomsky): Guide to the Pomeranian × Siberian Husky cross.
- [Saint Berdoodle](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/saint-berdoodle): Guide to the Saint Bernard × Poodle cross.
- [Golden Mountain Dog](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/golden-mountain-dog): Guide to the Golden Retriever × Bernese Mountain Dog cross.
- [Teacup Poodle](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/teacup-poodle): Guide to the smallest Poodle size variant.
- [Mini Golden Retriever](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/mini-golden-retriever): Guide to the smaller Golden Retriever mix.
- [Mini Aussie](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/mini-aussie): Guide to the Miniature American/Australian Shepherd.
- [Toy Aussie](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/toy-aussie): Guide to the Toy-size Australian Shepherd.
- [Mini Dachshund](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/mini-dachshund): Guide to the Miniature Dachshund.
- [French Bulldog](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/french-bulldog): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the French Bulldog.
- [German Shepherd](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/german-shepherd): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the German Shepherd.
- [Cane Corso](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/cane-corso): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Cane Corso.
- [Dalmatian](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/dalmatian): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Dalmatian.
- [Belgian Malinois](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/belgian-malinois): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Belgian Malinois, the working breed behind Cairo and the John Wick films.
- [Boxer](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/boxer): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Boxer, the Bavarian working dog with the soul of a clown and a centuries-long talent for reading a room.
- [Great Dane](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/great-dane): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Great Dane, the Apollo of Dogs—a German gentle giant with an impressively short lifespan and an honest discussion of bloat risk.
- [Rottweiler](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/rottweiler): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Rottweiler, the German working dog descended from Roman legions and rebuilt by Hollywood as a villain—and why that's wrong.
- [Pug](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/pug): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Pug, the Chinese imperial companion breed with a distinctive flat face and serious health considerations every owner should know.
- [Shiba Inu](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/shiba-inu): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Shiba Inu, Japan's ancient hunting dog—small but unbothered, with the independent spirit of a working dog and internet fame via the Doge meme.
- [Samoyed](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/samoyed): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Samoyed, the Arctic sled dog bred by the Samoyede people of northern Siberia for millennia, known for its white coat and the distinctive "Smiling Sammie" expression.
- [Maltese](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/maltese): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Maltese, one of the oldest toy companion breeds.
- [Bernese Mountain Dog](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/bernese-mountain-dog): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Bernese Mountain Dog, a Swiss farm and draft breed.
- [Vizsla](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/vizsla): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Vizsla, Hungary's velvet-coated hunting dog.
- [Chocolate Lab](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/chocolate-lab): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Chocolate Lab, the recessive-gene color variant of the Labrador Retriever.
- [Mini French Bulldog](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/mini-french-bulldog): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Mini French Bulldog, an unofficial size variant of the French Bulldog.
- [Giant Schnauzer](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/giant-schnauzer): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Giant Schnauzer, the Bavarian cattle-drover and brewery-guard breed.
- [Newfoundland](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/newfoundland): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Newfoundland, Canada's gentle giant water-rescue breed.
- [American Bully](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/american-bully): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the American Bully, including the 2024 UK XL Bully ban and other breed-specific legislation.
- [Agouti Husky](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/agouti-husky): Guide to the rare agouti/wolf-sable Siberian Husky coat color, made famous by the sled dog Togo.
- [Poodle](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/poodle): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Poodle, the working water retriever behind every doodle cross on this site.
- [Australian Shepherd](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/australian-shepherd): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Australian Shepherd, the American ranch dog behind the Mini Aussie and Toy Aussie.
- [Golden Retriever](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/golden-retriever): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Golden Retriever, the Scottish gundog behind the Goldendoodle, Mini Golden Retriever, and Golden Mountain Dog.
- [Labrador Retriever](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/labrador-retriever): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Labrador Retriever, America's longest-reigning most-popular breed and the parent of the Labradoodle and Chocolate Lab.
- [Siberian Husky](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/siberian-husky): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Siberian Husky, the Chukchi sled dog behind Balto, the Iditarod, the Pomsky, and the Agouti Husky.
- [Dachshund](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/dachshund): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Dachshund, the German badger-hunting hound and parent of the Mini Dachshund.
- [Aussiedoodle](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/aussiedoodle): Guide to the Australian Shepherd × Poodle cross.
- [Sheepadoodle](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/sheepadoodle): Guide to the Old English Sheepdog × Poodle cross.
- [Corgi](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/corgi): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Pembroke Welsh Corgi, the Welsh cattle-heeler behind Queen Elizabeth II's Pembrokes.
- [Shih Tzu](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/shih-tzu): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Shih Tzu, the Chinese imperial court companion breed.
- [Yorkshire Terrier](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/yorkshire-terrier): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Yorkshire Terrier, the Yorkshire mill ratter behind Smoky the war dog and Audrey Hepburn's Mr. Famous.
- [Pomeranian](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/pomeranian): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Pomeranian, the Spitz sled dog Queen Victoria bred down to lap size, and the parent of the Pomsky.
- [Beagle](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/beagle): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Beagle, the English pack hound whose nose has gotten it into more trouble than its judgment can talk its way out of.
- [Border Collie](https://dogshow.lol/breeds/border-collie): Temperament, care, and owner-fit for the Border Collie, the Scotland-England border herder with one of the sharpest minds in the dog world — Chaser's record-breaking 1,022-toy vocabulary.

## Enter your dog & contests
- [How to enter a dog show](https://dogshow.lol/how-to-enter-a-dog-show): Step-by-step guide to entering a dog show — the traditional in-person route and the online route via The Dog Show. Q&A format.
- [How dog shows work online](https://dogshow.lol/how-online-dog-shows-work): Explainer on how online dog shows work in 2026 — traditional vs. online, static photo contests vs. live rotating shows, and how voting and Best in Show work. Q&A format.
- [Enter your dog](https://dogshow.lol/?openModal=premium): Upload your dog for free and watch it take the stage in the rotation.
- [Dog photo contest](https://dogshow.lol/dog-photo-contest): How The Dog Show works as an online dog photo contest.
- [Cutest dog contest](https://dogshow.lol/cutest-dog-contest): A judge-free cutest-dog contest where every dog is the cutest.
- [Puppy picture contest](https://dogshow.lol/puppy-picture-contest): How to enter a puppy in the show.
- [Dog show near me](https://dogshow.lol/dog-show-near-me): The live online dog show you can join from anywhere.
